blockers.description: Cut the hardened launch release and verify archives, installers, signatures, attestations, SBOM, Homebrew, MSI, and cargo install from clean environments. The v0.1.2-beta.1 tag was pushed on 2026-05-21, but the release workflow stopped before artifact publication because the dist matrix command allowlist rejected the generated cargo-dist installer commands. The v0.1.2-beta.2 replacement tag was pushed on 2026-05-22, but artifact smoke gates rejected the published claw-vcs-* cargo-dist asset names. The v0.1.2-beta.3 replacement tag built artifacts and passed Windows archive smoke, but Unix archive smoke reused the extracted claw binary as a relative path after changing directories.
